    ada = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "ada@example.com",
                                         "password": "correct horse"}).json()["token"]
    bob = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "bob@example.com",
                                         "password": "correct horse"}).json()["token"]
    cy = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "cy@example.com",
                                        "password": "correct horse"}).json()["token"]
    H = lambda tok: {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}  # noqa: E731

    # ---- /me as_of
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada))
    check("/me current balance", r.json()["balance"] == M.users["ada"] == 10000)
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada), params={"as_of": iso(t0)})
    b = r.json()
    check("/me at exactly seeded instant counts it",
          b["balance"] == M.bal_at("ada", t0) == 10000 and b["as_of"] == iso(t0), b)
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada), params={"as_of": iso(t0 - timedelta(seconds=1))})
    check("/me before earliest payment = opening 10500",
          r.json()["balance"] == M.bal_at("ada", t0 - timedelta(seconds=1)) == 10500)
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada),
                 params={"as_of": iso(datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=1))})
    check("/me future as_of = current", r.json()["balance"] == M.users["ada"])
    for bad in ("2026-10-05T12:00:00", "2026-10-05", "", "nope"):
        r = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada), params={"as_of": bad})
        check("/me bad as_of %r -> 422" % bad, r.status_code == 422, r.status_code)
    # future seeded created_at is a reset error and changes nothing
    fx_future = json.loads(json.dumps(fixture()))
    fx_future["payments"][0]["created_at"] = iso(datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=1))
    before = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada)).json()["balance"]
    r = http.post("/_test/reset", json=fx_future)
    check("future seeded created_at -> 422", r.status_code == 422, r.text)
    after = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada)).json()["balance"]
    check("rejected reset changed nothing", before == after)
    r = http.post("/_test/reset", json=fixture())
    assert r.status_code == 204

    # ---- payments for statement building
    p1 = http.post("/payments", headers={**H(ada), "Idempotency-Key": key()},
                   json={"to_handle": "bob", "amount": 300}).json()
    M.pay("ada", "bob", 300, pid=p1["payment_id"], eff=datetime.fromisoformat(p1["created_at"]))
    p2 = http.post("/payments", headers={**H(ada), "Idempotency-Key": key()},
                   json={"to_handle": "bob", "amount": 200}).json()
    M.pay("ada", "bob", 200, pid=p2["payment_id"], eff=datetime.fromisoformat(p2["created_at"]))
    pcx = http.post("/payments", headers={**H(bob), "Idempotency-Key": key()},
                    json={"to_handle": "cy", "amount": 100, "visibility": "public"}).json()
    M.pay("bob", "cy", 100, pid=pcx["payment_id"],
          eff=datetime.fromisoformat(pcx["created_at"]))

    # ---- statement arithmetic + ordering
    st = http.get("/statement", headers=H(ada)).json()
    check("statement entries = 3 (seeded + 2)", len(st["entries"]) == 3, st)
    check("statement oldest first", [e["payment"]["payment_id"] for e in st["entries"]]
          == ["p_s1", p1["payment_id"], p2["payment_id"]], st)
    check("statement deltas", [e["delta"] for e in st["entries"]] == [-500, -300, -200])
    running = st["opening_balance"]
    ok = running == M.opening["ada"] == 10500
    for e in st["entries"]:
        running += e["delta"]
        ok = ok and e["balance_after"] == running
    check("statement walks the balance forward from opening 10500",
          ok and st["closing_balance"] == M.users["ada"], (st["opening_balance"],
                                                           st["closing_balance"]))
    check("statement excludes third-party public payment",
          all(e["payment"]["to_handle"] != "cy" for e in st["entries"]))
    check("statement entries carry revision fields",
          all(e["revision"] == 1 and e["effective_at"] and e["recorded_at"]
              for e in st["entries"]))
    check("statement has snapshot tok... [truncated] ..."authorization_id"], headers=H(cy))
    azl = http.get("/authorizations", headers=H(cy)).json()["authorizations"]
    voided = next(a for a in azl if a["authorization_id"] == az2["authorization_id"])
    check("voided authorization has closed_at",
          voided["closed_at"] is not None and voided["status"] == "voided", voided)
    created = datetime.fromisoformat(az2["created_at"])
    closed = datetime.fromisoformat(voided["closed_at"])
    mid = (created + closed) / 2
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(cy), params={"as_of": iso(mid)})
    check("/me historical: hold existed mid-lifecycle", r.json()["held"] == 100, r.json())
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(cy), params={"as_of": iso(closed + timedelta(seconds=1))})
    check("/me historical: hold released after void", r.json()["held"] == 0, r.json())
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(cy),
                 params={"as_of": iso(mid), "known_at": iso(mid)})
    check("/me historical both instants", r.json()["held"] == 100, r.json())
    # unknown_at before the authorization existed -> no hold, not even currently
    r = http.get("/me", headers=H(cy), params={"known_at": iso(created - timedelta(seconds=1))})
    check("/me known_at before creation: no hold", r.json()["held"] == 0, r.json())

    M4.pay("ada", "bob", 1234, pid=pa["payment_id"])
    k = key()
    c1 = http.post("/payments/%s/corrections" % pa["payment_id"],
                   headers={**H(ada), "Idempotency-Key": k},
                   json={"expected_revision": 1, "amount": 999,
                         "effective_at": pa["created_at"], "reason": "r"}).json()
    M4.correct(pa["payment_id"], 999, datetime.fromisoformat(pa["created_at"]))
    az = http.post("/authorizations", headers={**H(bob), "Idempotency-Key": key()},
                   json={"to_handle": "ada", "amount": 77}).json()
    st = http.get("/statement", headers=H(ada)).json()
    snap_tok = st["snapshot"]
    exp = http.get("/_test/export").json()
    # mutate, then wipe

          me["balance"] == M4.users["ada"] - 5, (me, M4.users["ada"]))
    revs = http.get("/payments/%s/revisions" % pa["payment_id"],

    me = http.get("/me", headers=H(ada)).json()

    r2 = http.post("/payments/%s/corrections" % pa["payment_id"],
                   headers={**H(ada), "Idempotency-Key": k},
                   json={"expected_revision": 1, "amount": 999,
                         "effective_at": pa["created_at"], "reason": "r"})
    check("imported state: correction replay 200 identical",
          r2.status_code == 200 and r2.json() == c1, (r2.status_code, r2.text[:100]))

              for a in azl), azl)
    me = http.get("/me", headers=H2()).json()
    check("imported state: held preserved", me["held"] == 77, me)

    e = next(x for x in st2["entries"] if x["payment"]["payment_id"] == pa["payment_id"])

    check("imported state: old snapshot still pages",

    r = http.post("/_test/reset", json=fx4)

    check("snapshot dead after reset", r.status_code == 404)

    # ---- import a STAGE-2 export (no revisions) — upgrade path sanity
    # The harness drives this against :18092, but sanity-check the shape here

    check("stage-2 export imports into stage-3", r.status_code == 204, r.text)
    ada3 = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "ada@example.com",

"""Double-fork daemonizer: start dockerd if not already up. Idempotent."""
import os, subprocess, sys, time

def up():
    try:
        return subprocess.run(["docker", "info"], capture_output=True, timeout=5).returncode == 0
    except Exception:
        return False

if up():
    print("already running")
    sys.exit(0)

pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.setsid()
    pid2 = os.fork()
    if pid2 == 0:
        devnull = open(os.devnull)
        log = open("/var/log/dockerd-manual.log", "ab")
        os.dup2(devnull.fileno(), 0)
        os.dup2(log.fileno(), 1)
        os.dup2(log.fileno(), 2)
        os.execvp("dockerd", ["dockerd", "--iptables=false", "--ip6tables=false",
                              "--bridge=none", "--storage-driver=vfs"])
        os._exit(127)
    os._exit(0)
os.waitpid(pid, 0)

for _ in range(40):
    if up():
        print("dockerd up")
        sys.exit(0)
    time.sleep(0.5)
print("dockerd failed to start", file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(1)

{"name": "write", "args": {"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Import python:3.12-alpine (linux/amd64) into the local docker store by
fetching token/manifest/blobs with curl and `docker import`ing the merged rootfs."""
import io, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tarfile, pathlib

REG = "https://registry-1.docker.io"
AUTH = "https://auth.docker.io/token"
REPO, TAG = "library/python", "3.12-alpine"
STAGE = pathlib.Path("/tmp/opencode/rootfs-staging")
OUT_TAR = "/tmp/opencode/py312-alpine-rootfs.tar"


def curl(*args):
    r = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", *args], capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"curl failed: {args}: {r.stderr[:500]}")
    return r.stdout


print("1/4 token")
tok = json.loads(curl(f"{AUTH}?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:{REPO}:pull"))["token"]
ACC = ["-H", "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.list.v1+json, "
          "application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json, "
          "application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json, "
          "application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json, "
          "application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json"]

print("2/4 manifest")
ml = json.loads(curl(f"{REG}/v2/{REPO}/manifests/{TAG}",
                     "-H", f"Authorization: Bearer {tok}", *ACC))
if "manifests" in ml:
    entry = next(m for m in ml["manifests"]
                 if m["platform"]["architecture"] == "amd64"
                 and m["platform"]["os"] == "linux")
    digest = entry["digest"]
    print("   platform manifest:", digest)
    r = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", "-H", f"Authorization: Bearer {tok}",
                        "-H", f"Digest: {digest}",
                        "-H", "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json, "
                              "application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json",
                        f"{REG}/v2/{REPO}/manifests/{digest}"], capture_output=True)
    mf = json.loads(r.stdout)
else:
    mf = ml

layers = []
for l in mf.get("layers", []):
    mt = l.get("mediaType", "")
    if "layer" in mt and "gzip" in mt:
        layers.append((l["digest"], l["size"]))
    else:
        print("   SKIP layer mediaType:", mt)
if not layers:
    sys.exit("no layers found in manifest")
print(f"   {len(layers)} layers")


def extract_layer(data):
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data), mode="r:gz") as tf:
        for m in tf.getmembers():
            name = m.name.lstrip("./")
            parts = name.split("/")
            if any(p.startswith(".wh.") for p in parts):
                base = "/".join(parts[:-1])
                tgt = os.path.join(STAGE, base, parts[-1][4:]) if len(parts) > 1 \
                    else os.path.join(STAGE, parts[-1][4:])
                if os.path.isdir(tgt) and not os.path.islink(tgt):
                    shutil.rmtree(tgt)
                elif os.path.lexists(tgt):
                    os.remove(tgt)
                continue
            dest = os.path.join(STAGE, name)
            if m.isdir():
                os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True)
            elif m.issym():
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest) or ".", exist_ok=True)
                if os.path.lexists(dest):
                    os.remove(dest)
                os.symlink(m.linkname, dest)
            elif m.islnk():
                target = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(dest),
                                                       m.linkname))
                if os.path.lexists(target) and os.path.isfile(target):
                    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest) or ".", exist_ok=True)
                    if os.path.lexists(dest):
                        os.remove(dest)
                    os.link(target, dest)
                else:
                    f = tf.extractfile(m)
                    if f is not None:
                        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest) or ".", exist_ok=True)
                        with open(dest, "wb") as out:
                            shutil.copyfileobj(f, out)
            elif m.isreg():
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest) or ".", exist_ok=True)
                f = tf.extractfile(m)
                with open(dest, "wb") as out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(f, out)


print("3/4 blobs -> staging")
if STAGE.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(STAGE)
STAGE.mkdir(parents=True)
for i, (d, size) in enumerate(layers, 1):
    print(f"   layer {i}/{len(layers)} {d[:19]} ({size} B)")
    r = subprocess.run(["curl", "-sL", "--fail", "-H", f"Authorization: Bearer {tok}",
                        f"{REG}/v2/{REPO}/blobs/{d}"], capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode != 0 or not r.stdout:
        sys.exit(f"blob fetch failed {d}: {r.stderr[:300]}")
    if len(r.stdout) != size:
        print(f"   WARN size mismatch {len(r.stdout)} != {size}")
    extract_layer(r.stdout)

print("4/4 tar + import")
if os.path.exists(OUT_TAR):
    os.remove(OUT_TAR)
with tarfile.open(OUT_TAR, "w") as tf:
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(STAGE):
        for n in sorted(dirs) + sorted(files):
            p = os.path.join(root, n)
            tf.add(p, arcname=os.path.relpath(p, STAGE), recursive=False)
subprocess.run(["docker", "rmi", "python:3.12-alpine"], capture_output=True)
r = subprocess.run(["docker", "import",
                    "--change", "ENV PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin",
                    "--change", "CMD [\"sh\"]",
                    OUT_TAR, "python:3.12-alpine"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.stdout.strip() or r.stderr.strip())
r = subprocess.run(["docker", "image", "inspect", "python:3.12-alpine", "--format",
                    "{{.Id}} {{.Size}}"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("image:", r.stdout.strip() or r.stderr.strip())

{"name": "write", "args": {"content": """"UI probes for the demonstrated stage-2 paths (D1/D2) — regression check."""
import sys

import httpx
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:18091"
results = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    results.append((name, bool(cond), detail))
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + name + ("" if cond else "  :: " + str(detail)))


def sel(name):
    return "[data-testid='{}']".format(name)


def fixture():
    return {
        "currency": "EUR", "minor_units": 2,
        "users": [
            {"id": "u_ada", "email": "ada@example.com", "password": "correct horse",
             "display_name": "Ada", "handle": "ada", "balance": 10000},
            {"id": "u_bob", "email": "bob@example.com", "password": "correct horse",
             "display_name": "Bob", "handle": "bob", "balance": 2500},
            {"id": "u_cy", "email": "cy@example.com", "password": "correct horse",
             "display_name": "Cy", "handle": "cy", "balance": 500},
        ],
        "payments": [], "requests": [],
    }


def api_login(http, email):
    r = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": email, "password": "correct horse"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return r.json()["token"]


def open_authz(http, token):
    aids = http.get("/authorizations",
                    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token}).json()["authorizations"]
    return [a["authorization_id"] for a in aids if a["status"] == "open"]


def login(page, email):
    page.goto(BASE + "/login")
    page.fill(sel("login-email"), email)
    page.fill(sel("login-password"), "correct horse")
    page.click(sel("login-submit"))
    page.wait_for_selector(sel("current-user"))


with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch()
    http = httpx.Client(base_url=BASE, timeout=10)
    r = http.post("/_test/reset", json=fixture())
    assert r.status_code == 204, r.text
    ada_tok = api_login(http, "ada@example.com")
    bob_tok = api_login(http, "bob@example.com")

    ada_page = browser.new_context().new_page()
    login(ada_page, "ada@example.com")

    # ---- 1. Ada authorizes 10.00 to Bob from the UI
    ada_page.goto(BASE + "/")
    ada_page.wait_for_selector(sel("pay-submit"))
    ada_page.fill(sel("authorize-handle"), "bob")
    ada_page.fill(sel("authorize-amount"), "10.00")
    ada_page.fill(sel("authorize-note"), "deposit")
    ada_page.click(sel("authorize-submit"))
    ada_page.wait_for_selector(sel("wallet-held"))
    check("hold appears on authorizer wallet",
          ada_page.get_attribute(sel("wallet-held"), "data-amount") == "1000")
    check("available falls once",
          ada_page.get_attribute(sel("wallet-available"), "data-amount") == "9000")
    aid = open_authz(http, ada_tok)[0]

    # ---- 2. Bob: incoming open authorization, decimal pre-fill, plain capture click
    bob_page = browser.new_context().new_page()
    login(bob_page, "bob@example.com")
    bob_page.goto(BASE + "/authorizations")
    bob_page.wait_for_selector(sel("authorization-item-" + aid))
    prefill = bob_page.get_attribute(sel("authorization-capture-amount-" + aid), "value")
    check("capture input pre-filled with decimal remaining", prefill == "10.00", prefill)
    bob_page.click(sel("authorization-capture-" + aid))   # plain click, untouched input
    bob_page.wait_for_selector(f"{sel('authorization-item-' + aid)}[data-status='captured']")
    check("plain capture click captures (D2)", True)
    cap_txt = bob_page.text_content(sel("authorization-captured-" + aid))
    check("captured amount formatted", cap_txt.strip() == "10.00 EUR", cap_txt)
    check("no error slot shown after successful capture",
          bob_page.query_selector(sel("authorization-error")) is None)
    bob_page.goto(BASE + "/")
    bob_page.wait_for_selector('[data-testid^="activity-item-"]')
    check("capture payment shows in feed", True)

    # ---- 3. Ada authorizes 5.00 again; the receiver has no void button
    ada_page.goto(BASE + "/")
    ada_page.fill(sel("authorize-handle"), "bob")
    ada_page.fill(sel("authorize-amount"), "5.00")
    ada_page.click(sel("authorize-submit"))
    aid2 = open_authz(http, ada_tok)[0]
    bob_page.goto(BASE + "/authorizations")
    bob_page.wait_for_selector(sel("authorization-item-" + aid2))
    check("void button hidden for receiver",
          bob_page.query_selector(sel("authorization-void-" + aid2)) is None)

    # ---- 4. Void by the payer (Ada)
    ada_page.goto(BASE + "/authorizations")
    ada_page.wait_for_selector(sel("authorization-item-" + aid2))
    ada_page.click(sel("authorization-void-" + aid2))
    ada_page.wait_for_selector(f"{sel('authorization-item-' + aid2)}[data-status='voided']")
    check("voided item updates without manual reload (D1)", True)
    check("void button gone after void",
          ada_page.query_selector(sel("authorization-void-" + aid2)) is None)
    check("no error after successful void",
          ada_page.query_selector(sel("authorization-error")) is None)
    ada_page.goto(BASE + "/")
    ada_page.wait_for_selector(sel("wallet-available"))
    check("hold released after void",
          ada_page.get_attribute(sel("wallet-available"), "data-amount") == "9000")

    # ---- 5. Refused capture: over-capture shows the error and survives the rerender
    ada_page.goto(BASE + "/")
    ada_page.fill(sel("authorize-handle"), "bob")
    ada_page.fill(sel("authorize-amount"), "3.00")
    ada_page.click(sel("authorize-submit"))
    aid3 = open_authz(http, ada_tok)[0]
    bob_page.goto(BASE + "/authorizations")
    bob_page.wait_for_selector(sel("authorization-item-" + aid3))
    bob_page.fill(sel("authorization-capture-amount-" + aid3), "999.99")
    bob_page.click(sel("authorization-capture-" + aid3))
    bob_page.wait_for_selector(sel("authorization-error"), timeout=15000)
    err = bob_page.query_selector(sel("authorization-error"))
    check("refused capture shows authorization-error (survives rerender)",
          err is not None and err.text_content().strip() != "",
          err.text_content() if err else None)
    check("refused capture leaves item open with capture button",
          bob_page.get_attribute(sel("authorization-item-" + aid3), "data-status") == "open"
          and bob_page.query_selector(sel("authorization-capture-" + aid3)) is not None)
    held = http.get("/me", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + ada_tok}).json()
    check("no money moved on refused capture (Ada: 9000 total, 300 held)",
          held["total"] == 9000 and held["held"] == 300 and held["available"] == 8700, held)

    # ---- 6. Void by a non-payer is refused; payer can still void
    r = http.post("/authorizations/{}/void".format(aid3),
                  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + bob_tok})
    check("void by non-payer is 403 via API", r.status_code == 403, r.status_code)
    ada_page.goto(BASE + "/authorizations")
    ada_page.wait_for_selector(sel("authorization-item-" + aid3))
    ada_page.click(sel("authorization-void-" + aid3))
    ada_page.wait_for_selector(f"{sel('authorization-item-' + aid3)}[data-status='voided']")
    check("payer void works after refused void elsewhere", True)

    http.close()
    browser.close()

failed = [n for n, ok, d in results if not ok]
print("\n{} checks, {} failed".format(len(results), len(failed)))
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)

1: # Pocketful — Stage 3: statements and payment corrections
2: 
3: The requirements from stages 1 and 2 continue to apply, with the additions below.
4: Numbered section references such as §5 and §7 refer to `stage-1.md`.
5: 
6: Users can request historical balances and paginated statements. Senders can correct
7: eligible payments while preserving the original receipt. Historical queries must support
8: both the effective date of a payment and the information available at a specified time.
9: 
10: ## Payment timestamps
11: 
12: Every payment's `created_at` is an RFC 3339 instant with an offset identifying when it
13: moved money. Every endpoint returning a payment includes it. `GET /activity` retains its
14: existing ordering by this field.
15: 
16: Seeded payments may supply `created_at`; omission uses reset time, before subsequent
17: API-created payments. A seeded `created_at` in the future gives `422 validation_failed`
18: from `POST /_test/reset`, with no state change.
19: 
20: A fixture's `balance` remains the balance after all seeded payments. Loading those
21: payments must not change that balance.
22: 
23: ## `GET /me` as of an instant
24: 
25: ```http
26: GET /me?as_of=2026-09-24T13:20:00%2B00:00
27: ```
28: 
29: `as_of` is optional and is an RFC 3339 instant with an offset. Anything else — a naive local
30: time, a bare date, an empty value — is 422 `validation_failed`. Without temporal query
31: parameters the response retains the existing money fields and reports current corrected values.
32: 
33: With it, `balance` is the caller's balance as it stood at that instant: the balance after every
34: payment of theirs with `created_at` at or before `as_of`, and before every payment after it. A
35: payment made at exactly `as_of` counts as having happened.
36: 
37: - An `as_of` at or after the latest payment returns the current balance.
38: - An `as_of` before the earliest payment returns the opening balance — what the wallet held
39:   before anything moved.
40: - The response carries `as_of` back, exactly as given.
41: 
42: ## `GET /statement`
43: 
44: ```http
45: GET /statement?from=<instant>&to=<instant>&limit=50&offset=0
46: ```
47: 
48: Both `from` and `to` are optional; `from` defaults to the opening of the wallet and `to` to now.
49: `limit` and `offset` behave exactly as in `GET /requests`.
50: 
51: Returns the payments the caller sent or received in the half-open window `[from, to)`, **oldest
52: first**, each with the caller's balance immediately after it:
53: 
54: This abbreviated example omits the revision fields and `snapshot` token described below.
55: 
56: ```json
57: { "opening_balance": 10000,
58:   "entries": [
59:     { "payment": { "...": "..." }, "delta": -500, "balance_after": 9500 },
60:     { "payment": { "...": "..." }, "delta": 1200, "balance_after": 10700 }
61:   ],
62:   "closing_balance": 10700,
63:   "has_more": false }
64: ```
65: 
66: Statement requirements:
67: 
68: 1. Entries are ordered by `created_at` ascending, then payment `id` ascending for ties.
69: 2. `opening_balance` is the balance immediately before `from`. `closing_balance` is the
70:    balance immediately before `to`.
71: 3. `opening_balance` plus all `delta` values in the full window must equal `closing_balance`.
72:    A sent payment has a negative `delta`; a received payment has a positive `delta`.
73: 4. Pagination must not change an entry's `balance_after` or the window's opening and closing
74:    balances. These values describe the full window regardless of `limit` and `offset`.
75: 
76: Only payments sent or received by the caller appear in their statement, including when
77: other payments are public. The activity-feed visibility rules do not apply to statements.
78: 
79: ## Effective time, recorded time, and corrections
80: 
81: The service must distinguish **when money took effect** from **when it learned that fact**.
82: Every payment has a revision history. Revision 1 has `amount` as originally paid and
83: `effective_at = recorded_at = created_at`. A seeded payment's supplied `created_at` is also
84: its original recorded/effective time; omission uses reset time. Opening balances equal
85: seeded ending balances minus the net effect of original seeded payments. Corrections must
86: not change those opening balances. New accounts open at zero. Seeded history is consistent
87: and nonnegative.
88: 
89: `POST /payments/{payment_id}/corrections` requires an idempotency key and the original sender.
90: An authenticated non-sender gets 403 `forbidden`; unknown payment gets 404. Body:
91: 
92: ```json
93: {"expected_revision": 1, "amount": 400,
94:  "effective_at": "2026-09-20T12:00:00+00:00", "reason": "corrected amount"}
95: ```
96: 
97: All fields are required. Revision is a positive integer; amount is an integer 0..1000000000
98: (zero reverses the entire payment); reason is a string of 1..200 characters; effective time
99: is an RFC 3339 instant not later than now. Invalid input is 422 `validation_failed`.
100: Correction changes neither parties nor visibility. It appends an immutable revision, returning
101: 201 with `payment_id`, `revision`, `amount`, `effective_at`, server-assigned `recorded_at`,
102: and `reason`. Recorded times for one payment strictly increase. A stale expected revision
103: gives 409 `stale_revision`. Successful replay returns that original revision with 200 even
104: after newer revisions. Different body with the same key is 409 `idempotency_key_reuse`.
105: 
106: The difference from the previous amount moves between the **same two wallets** in the same
107: atomic step. Increasing the amount debits the original sender; decreasing it debits the
108: original receiver. A currently unaffordable debit gives 409 `insufficient_funds`. Otherwise,
109: if any user's corrected balance is negative at any effective-time boundary, return
110: 409 `historical_overdraft`. Balances at a boundary include the combined effect of all
111: movements at that instant. Either failure preserves balances, revision history, statements
112: and idempotency state. The sum of balances must equal the seeded total in every historical view.
113: 
114: The original payment and every original idempotent response remain unchanged. `GET /activity`
115: continues to display the original payment; correction records are not new feed payments.
116: `GET /payments/{payment_id}/revisions` returns `{"revisions": [...]}` in revision order,
117: including revision 1 (`reason: ""`). Only the two parties can read it; a third party gets
118: 404 even for a public payment. No token is 401.
119: 
120: `GET /me` and `GET /statement` accept optional `known_at`, an RFC 3339 instant with offset.
121: For each payment, select its latest revision recorded **at or before** `known_at`; if none
122: was yet recorded, that payment contributes nothing. Omission means everything known when the
123: read begins. Then apply selected revisions according to their **effective** times. `as_of`
124: retains its inclusive meaning; a statement retains its half-open window. Both query instants
125: may be in the future. Invalid/empty instants are 422. Echo supplied `known_at` exactly.
126: 
127: Statement ordering is now by selected `effective_at`, then payment id. Each entry retains
128: `payment`, `delta` and `balance_after`, and adds the selected `revision`, `effective_at` and
129: `recorded_at`. `payment.amount` is the selected amount for this statement. Zero-amount
130: revisions still appear as entries with zero delta. No correction is counted alongside the
131: revision it replaces. With no corrections and no `known_at`, previous behavior is unchanged.
132: 
133: ## Stable statement pagination
134: 
135: Every first `GET /statement` response additionally returns an opaque `snapshot` token.
136: It freezes the caller's selected revisions, window, balances, entries and default `to` at
137: that read. `GET /statement?snapshot=<token>&limit=...&offset=...` pages that exact result,
138: even after payments or corrections. Only limit and offset may accompany a snapshot; supplying
139: `from`, `to` or `known_at` with it gives 422 `validation_failed`. Unknown token, another user's
140: token, or a token from before reset gives 404 `not_found`. Tokens last until reset. No storage
141: survival across container restarts is required. Paging changes neither balances nor entries;
142: the final partial page and offsets beyond the end must report `has_more` correctly.
143: Unrecognized query parameters remain ignored under stage 1's general rule.
144: 
145: A correction may move a payment into or out of a statement window. Existing snapshots
146: remain unchanged during concurrent payments or corrections. Concurrent corrections using
147: the same expected revision cannot both succeed.
148: 
149: ## Settlement history
150: 
151: Stage-1 settlements retain their original receipts and privacy rules. Each member's original
152: revision uses its shared committed_at as both effective_at and recorded_at.
153: Single-payment corrections reject settlement members with 422 `linked_payment_immutable`.
154: 
155: A stage-3 service must accept exports produced by the same team's stage-1 or stage-2
156: service. The ledger must import and account for authorizations and captures. Captures are
157: immutable linked payments: a correction of a capture gives 422 `linked_payment_immutable`.
158: 
159: ## Historical holds
160: 
161: For `GET /me?as_of=T&known_at=K`, all four money fields describe that same view:
162: `balance = total`, `available = total - held`. A hold starts at authorization creation;
163: nonfinal capture reduces it at capture time; final capture, void or expiry releases the
164: remainder at that event's time. Expiry takes effect at `expires_at`. Events other than clock
165: expiry are known at their
166: server-assigned event time. Once creation is known, the expiry deadline is known too.
167: For queries beyond now, an open hold expires at its deadline. Without `as_of`, use the instant
168: the request began. Authorizations expose `closed_at` (null while open; event time when closed).
169: 
170: Historical `total` follows stage-3 effective/recorded-time rules. A correction is rejected
171: with 409 `historical_overdraft` if it makes either total or available negative at any past
172: effective/event boundary, under the latest known revisions. Current unaffordable debits
173: still take precedence as `insufficient_funds`. Seeded open holds are assumed created at reset
174: unless `created_at` is supplied; seeded closed holds need not reconstruct a prior lifecycle.
175: `GET /statement` still contains money movements only: authorization, release and expiry are
176: not payments. Captures appear exactly once with their links. Old snapshots remain unchanged
177: after any lifecycle action or correction.

# Pocketful — stage 3

Statements and payment corrections on top of the stage-2 service.
Python 3 standard library only; no build steps, no runtime
dependencies, no outbound network access required.

This stage extends stage 1 and 2 (all of whose behaviour continues to
apply) with:

- per-payment revision histories and `POST /payments/{id}/corrections`
  (the eighth idempotent write path), `GET /payments/{id}/revisions`
- historical queries: `GET /me` and `GET /statement` accept `as_of` and
  `known_at` RFC 3339 instants
- `GET /statement` — the caller's money movements in `[from, to)` with
  per-entry `balance_after`, and opaque `snapshot` tokens for stable
  pagination
- seeded payments may carry `created_at`; authorizations carry `closed_at`

## Build (Docker)

```sh
docker build -t pocketful-stage3 .
```

## Run (Docker)

```sh
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 -e PORT=8080 pocketful-stage3
```

The container listens on `0.0.0.0:$PORT` (default 8080). State is
in-memory; a restart starts empty.

## Run (native)

```sh
PORT=18091 python3 app.py
```

## Verify

```sh
curl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health
# -> {"status": "ok"}
```

The UI is served at `http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/` for `Accept: text/html`
requests; the same paths return JSON to API clients.

Then, from the official package (with a fresh `--out` folder per run; the
stage-2 service must be running for the upgrade checks):

```sh
cd <official-package>
env -u https_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY \
  NO_PROXY="127.0.0.1,localhost" no_proxy="127.0.0.1,localhost" \
  python -m harness run --track pocketful --base-url http://127.0.0.1:$PORT \
  --previous-base-url http://127.0.0.1:<stage2-port> \
  --stage 3 --out <fresh-out-folder>
```

         "display_name": "Bob", "handle": "bob", "balance": 2500},
    ],
}
h = httpx.Client(base_url=BASE, timeout=15)
print("reset:", h.post("/_test/reset", json=fx).status_code)
ada = h.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "ada@example.com", "password": "correct horse"}).json()
bob = h.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "bob@example.com", "password": "correct horse"}).json()
ah, bh = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + ada["token"]}, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + bob["token"]}

PASS = FAIL = 0


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    global PASS, FAIL
    if cond:
        PASS += 1
        print("  PASS  %s %s" % (name, detail))
    else:
        FAIL += 1
        print("  FAIL  %s %s" % (name, detail))


def sel(name):
    return "[data-testid='%s']" % name


def login(pg, email):
    pg.goto(BASE + "/login")
    pg.fill(sel("login-email"), email)
    pg.fill(sel("login-password"), "correct horse")
    pg.click(sel("login-submit"))
    pg.wait_for_selector(sel("current-user"))


def me(hdr):
    return h.get("/me", headers=hdr).json()


with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch()

    # ---- authorize form creates a hold; wallet shows held ----
    print("\n== authorize flow (ada) ==")
    pg = browser.new_page()
    login(pg, "ada@example.com")
    pg.goto(BASE + "/")
    pg.wait_for_selector(sel("authorize-submit"))
    pg.fill(sel("authorize-handle"), "bob")
    pg.fill(sel("authorize-amount"), "12.34")
    pg.select_option(sel("authorize-visibility"), "private")
    pg.fill(sel("authorize-note"), "deposit")
    pg.click(sel("authorize-submit"))
    pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    m = me(ah)
    check("authorize via UI: 1234 held, available 8766",
          m["held"] == 1234 and m["available"] == 8766 and m["balance"] == 10000, str(m))
    auths = h.get("/authorizations", headers=ah).json()["authorizations"]
    aid = auths[0]["authorization_id"]
    check("authorization private w/ note deposit",
          auths[0]["visibility"] == "private" and auths[0]["note"] == "deposit"
          and auths[0]["status"] == "open")
    check("wallet-available headline refreshed to 87.66",
          pg.get_attribute(sel("wallet-available"), "data-amount") == "8766")
    check("wallet-held present w/ 1234",
          pg.get_attribute(sel("wallet-held"), "data-amount") == "1234")
    pg.close()

    # ---- capture: decimal prefill + plain click (bob) ----
    print("\n== capture (bob) ==")
    pg = browser.new_page()
    login(pg, "bob@example.com")
    pg.goto(BASE + "/authorizations")
    pg.wait_for_selector(sel("authorization-item-" + aid))
    check("prefill is decimal 12.34", pg.input_value(sel("authorization-capture-amount-" + aid)) == "12.34",
          repr(pg.input_value(sel("authorization-capture-amount-" + aid))))
    check("item open, capture button present",
          pg.get_attribute(sel("authorization-item-" + aid), "data-status") == "open"
          and pg.query_selector(sel("authorization-capture-" + aid)) is not None)
    bob_before = me(bh)["balance"]
    pg.click(sel("authorization-capture-" + aid))

    check("no error on plain capture click",

    item = pg.query_selector(sel("authorization-item-" + aid))
    check("item now captured", item is not None and item.get_attribute("data-status") == "captured")
    check("captured amount 12.34 EUR shown",
          pg.text_content(sel("authorization-captured-" + aid)).strip() == "12.34 EUR")
    check("money moved once: bob +1234", me(bh)["balance"] == bob_before + 1234)
    check("wallet/feed refreshed on same page (wallet-available +12.34)",
          pg.get_attribute(sel("wallet-available"), "data-amount") == str(2500 + 1234))
    cap_pid = h.get("/authorizations", headers=bh).json()["authorizations"][0]["payment_id"]
    check("capture payment linked", cap_pid is not None)

3: Recipients can refund payments. Settlement operators can correct several payments in

11: ## Refunds and corrected history
12: 
13: `POST /payments/{payment_id}/refunds`, body `{"amount": 200}`, requires an idempotency key.
14: Only the original receiver may refund, else 403 `forbidden`; unknown payment is 404. The
15: target may be a direct payment, request payment or capture, but never a refund. Invalid amount
16: is 422 `validation_failed`. Refunds cumulatively may not exceed the payment's current corrected
17: amount: 422 `refund_exceeds_payment`. Refunds of refunds give 422 `invalid_refund_target`.
18: 
19: A refund is a new payment in the opposite direction, with `refund_of` naming the target,
20: `request_id: null`, `authorization_id: null`, and the original note/visibility. Return 201
21: with that payment; replay returns 200 with the original body. It moves existing money from
22: the receiver's **available** funds, or fails 409 `insufficient_funds`, atomically. Refunds
23: never reopen a request or authorization or restore a released hold. Other payments have
24: `refund_of: null`.
25: 
26: Stage-3 corrections remain available for ordinary direct/request payments. Captures and
27: refund payments cannot themselves be corrected: 422 `linked_payment_immutable`. A correction
28: cannot reduce a payment below its already-refunded amount: 422 `refund_exceeds_payment`.
29: Correction debits are checked against available funds.

38:                   "effective_at": "2026-09-20T12:00:00+00:00", "reason": "reversal"},
39:                  {"payment_id": "p_b", "expected_revision": 1, "amount": 0,
40:                   "effective_at": "2026-09-20T12:00:00+00:00", "reason": "reversal"}]}
41: ```

"""Stage 4 sample — the shipped smoke checks.

This is a sample, not the graded suite. It shows the shape of each surface once so a
service can be wired up against it; the spec is the contract and the graded checks are
the spec's. Passing everything here means the wiring is right, not that the stage holds.
"""
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

import fixtures as fx
from harness.http import assert_error, assert_status, new_key

pytestmark = pytest.mark.stage(4)


@pytest.fixture
def world(reset, api):
    seeded = fx.fixture()
    seeded["settlement_operator_ids"] = ["u_ada"]
    reset(seeded)
    return SimpleNamespace(
        ada=api().authenticate(fx.ADA["email"], fx.ADA["password"]),
        bob=api().authenticate(fx.BOB["email"], fx.BOB["password"]))


def pay(client, to_handle="bob", amount=1000):
    return assert_status(client.post("/payments", json={"to_handle": to_handle, "amount": amount},
                                     idempotency_key=new_key()), 201).json()


def refund(client, payment, amount=200, key=None):
    return client.post("/payments/" + payment["payment_id"] + "/refunds",
                       json={"amount": amount}, idempotency_key=key or new_key())


def batch(payment, amount=50):
    return {"corrections": [dict(payment_id=payment["payment_id"], expected_revision=1,
                                 amount=amount, effective_at=payment["created_at"],
                                 reason="correction")]}


def test_other_payments_carry_refund_of_null(world):
    assert pay(world.ada)["refund_of"] is None


def test_a_refund_is_a_linked_reverse_payment(world):
    payment = pay(world.ada)
    refunded = assert_status(refund(world.bob, payment), 201).json()
    assert refunded["refund_of"] == payment["payment_id"]
    assert (refunded["from_handle"], refunded["to_handle"], refunded["amount"]) == ("bob", "ada", 200)
    assert assert_status(world.ada.get("/me"), 200).json()["total"] == fx.ADA["balance"] - 800


def test_a_refund_replay_returns_the_original_body(world):

{"name": "write", "args": {"content": "# Pocketful stage 4 — design notes (refunds + batch corrections)

Basis: stage-3 tree at b736ea6 (verified). Stage 4 = stage 3 + refunds and
correction batches. No new UI surface in the spec; the stage-3 UI carries
forward unchanged ("existing receipts and saved statements remain available
in their original form" = old payments/snapshots still serve unchanged).

## Closed decisions
- D1 Refunds POST /payments/{pid}/refunds — 9th idempotent path.
  Receiver (target's to_user_id) only. Precedence after idem resolution:
  amount field (required; integral 1..1e9 per the shared amount rule — the
  spec gives no special zero case for refunds) → 422; target unknown → 404;
  caller != receiver → 403; target is itself a refund → 422
  invalid_refund_target; amount > target's current corrected amount −
  refunded → 422 refund_exceeds_payment; receiver available < amount → 409
  insufficient_funds; commit atomically. (404-before-403 mirrors stage-3
  corrections, which passed reviewer review.)
- D2 Refund payment: new payment, from = target's to, to = target's from,
  amount, note/visibility copied from the TARGET, refund_of = target id,
  request_id/settlement_id/authorization_id = null, created_at = now,
  revisions=[rev1]. It is an ordinary payment: appears in feed/statements/
  historical views by its own created_at; conservation holds (existing
  money). Replaying returns the original 201 body with 200.
- D3 Refunded tracking: p["refunded"] on the TARGET, incremented on commit.
  Invariant refunded ≤ current amount maintained by: refund check (D1) and
  the new correction rule (D4). Import: use stored value, default 0 for
  stage-1..3 exports. Refund payments can't be corrected, so per-refund
  amounts never change after creation.
- D4 Correction constraint: a correction's new amount < target's refunded →
  422 refund_exceeds_payment (item-level, before affordability). Applies to
  BOTH single corrections and batch items. "Correction debits are checked
  against available funds" — already the case (stage 3).
- D5 correction_allowed() (single path) now also excludes refunds:
  settlement_id, authorization_id, refund_of must all be None, else 422
  linked_payment_immutable. Settlement members remain blocked on the single
  path; captures and refunds blocked everywhere.
- D6 Batches POST /correction-batches — 10th idempotent path. Operator
  check first (401 handled by auth layer; non-operator 403), then idem
  resolution, then: corrections list 1..32 + all-string payment_ids +
  distinct ids (else 422) → per-item validation in INPUT ORDER (missing/
  invalid fields 422; unknown 404; capture-or-refund 422
  linked_payment_immutable; stale 409; proposed amount < refunded 422) →
  settlement completeness: any member corrected ⇒ ALL members of that
  settlement present as items (else 422 incomplete_settlement) → members of
  one settlement share one effective instant (compare parsed datetimes;
  offset spellings may differ, else 422 validation_failed) → affordability:
  combined effect — for every affected user, available(user) + net_delta ≥ 0
  (net = (new−old) if user is receiver, (old−new) if sender), else 409
  insufficient_funds → historical_ok for every affected user at the shared
  recorded time, else 409 historical_overdraft. Reject: no revision, no
  balance, no idem claim.
- D7 Batch commit: shared recorded_dt = max(now, max(last recorded of every
  member) + 1µs) — strictly later than every member's previous recorded_at;
  recorded_at = its iso. Each member gets one new revision carrying
  correction_batch_id = "cb_" + uuid hex[:16]. Response 201:
  {correction_batch_id, recorded_at, revisions: [revision objects, input
  order]}.
- D8 revision_obj gains correction_batch_id (null for non-batch revisions,
  incl. rev 1). Import of stage-1..3 exports: default None.
- D9 payment_obj gains refund_of (null except refunds). Seeded payments:
  refund_of None, refunded 0 (fixtures never carry these fields).
- D10 Routing: PAYMENT_ACTIONS regex gains "refunds" (POST, idempotent
  via _do_write); POST /correction-batches in the authed dispatch.
- D11 Import compatibility: accept snapshots missing refund_of/refunded/
  correction_batch_id (stages 1–3 exports). Settlement membership,
  corrections, snapshots retained as before.
- D12 No UI change. Stage-3 UI + all stage-2 probes must keep passing.
  Stage-1/2/3 API invariants unchanged (payments keep original amount in
  receipts; snapshots frozen; etc.).

## Watch-list
- R1 Graded suite ≈ 5× the 5-test sample. Corners: refund of a capture,
  refund of a settlement member, refund replay, cumulative refund cap,
  correction-after-refund cap (refund_exceeds_payment), batch with partial
  settlement, batch with two members different instants, batch operator
  checks, batch replay, concurrent stale, refund by non-receiver 403,
  refund of refund 422, batch idempotency per operator, historical check on
  combined batch effect.
- R2 "Current" refund cap uses the target's CURRENT corrected amount
  (latest revision), which a batch may be changing for a DIFFERENT payment —
  refund caps recompute from the refunded counter (invariant-protected).
- R3 A refund's source is the receiver's AVAILABLE (stage-2 semantics) —
  held funds can't fund refunds.

{"name": "write", "args": {"content": """"Stage-4 probe: refunds + correction batches, spec corners.

Expected values computed by a small local ledger model where needed."""
import json
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import httpx

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:18091"
PREV = "http://127.0.0.1:18092"   # stage-3 upgrade source
results = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    results.append((name, bool(cond), detail))
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + name + ("" if cond else "  :: " + str(detail)))


def key():
    return uuid.uuid4().hex


def fixture():
    return {
        "currency": "EUR", "minor_units": 2,
        "users": [
            {"id": "u_ada", "email": "ada@example.com", "password": "correct horse",
             "display_name": "Ada", "handle": "ada", "balance": 10000},
            {"id": "u_bob", "email": "bob@example.com", "password": "correct horse",
             "display_name": "Bob", "handle": "bob", "balance": 2500},
            {"id": "u_cy", "email": "cy@example.com", "password": "correct horse",
             "display_name": "Cy", "handle": "cy", "balance": 500},
        ],
        "payments": [], "requests": [], "settlement_operator_ids": ["u_ada"],
    }


def main():
    http = httpx.Client(base_url=BASE, timeout=10)
    http.cookies.clear()
    fx = fixture()
    assert http.post("/_test/reset", json=fx).status_code == 204
    ada = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "ada@example.com",
                                         "password": "correct horse"}).json()["token"]
    bob = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "bob@example.com",
                                         "password": "correct horse"}).json()["token"]
    cy = http.post("/auth/login", json={"email": "cy@example.com",
                                        "password": "correct horse"}).json()["token"]
    H = lambda t: {"Authorization": "Bearer " + t}  # noqa: E731

    def pay(tok, to, amount, **extra):
        body = {"to_handle": to, "amount": amount}
        body.update(extra)
        return http.post("/payments", headers={**H(tok), "Idempotency-Key": key()},
                         json=body)

    # ============ REFUNDS ============
    # normal payments carry refund_of: null
    p1 = pay(ada, "bob", 1000, note="dinner", visibility="private").json()
    check("normal payment refund_of is null", p1["refund_of"] is None, p1.get("refund_of"))

    # refund by the receiver (bob) -> reverse payment, refund_of set, note/visibility copied
    rf = http.post("/payments/%s/refunds" % p1["payment_id"],
                   headers={**H(bob), "Idempotency-Key": key()}, json={"amount": 200})
    rj = rf.json()
    check("refund 201", rf.status_code == 201, rf.text[:200])
    check("refund is reverse payment", (rj["from_handle"], rj["to_handle"], rj["amount"])
          == ("bob", "ada", 200), rj)
    check("refund sets refund_of", rj["refund_of"] == p1["payment_id"])
    check("refund copies note/visibility", rj["note"] == "dinner" and rj["visibility"] == "private", rj)
    check("refund request/settlement/authorization null",
          rj["request_id"] is None and rj["settlement_id"] is None
          and rj["authorization_id"] is None)
    # balances: ada 10000-1000+200=9200, bob 2500+1000-200=3300
    check("refund balances",
          http.get("/me", headers=H(ada)).json()["balance"] == 9200
          and http.get("/me", headers=H(bob)).json()["balance"] == 3300)

    # replay returns original body with 200
    k = key()
    rf1 = http.post("/payments/%s/refunds" % p1["payment_id"],
                    headers={**H(bob), "Idempotency-Key": k}, json={"amount": 100})
    rf2 = http.post("/payments/%s/refunds" % p1["payment_id"],
                    headers={**H(bob), "Idempotency-Key": k}, json={"amount": 100})
    check("refund replay 200 identical",
          rf1.status_code == 201 and rf2.status_code == 200 and rf1.json() == rf2.json())

    # non-receiver (ada) cannot refund p1 (receiver is bob)
    r = http.post("/payments/%s/refunds" % p1["payment_id"],
                  headers={**H(ada), "Idempotency-Key": key()}, json={"amount": 10})
    check("refund by non-receiver 403", r.status_code == 403
          and r.json()["error"]["code"] == "forbidden", r.text[:120])
    # unknown payment
    r = http.post("/payments/nope/refunds",
                  headers={**H(bob), "Idempotency-Key": key()}, json={"amount": 10})
    check("refund unknown payment 404", r.status_code == 404)
    # refund of a refund
    r = http.post("/payments/%s/refunds" % rj["payment_id"],
                  headers={**H(ada), "Idempotency-Key": key()}, json={"amount": 10})
    check("refund of a refund 422 invalid_refund_target",
          r.status_code == 422 and r.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_refund_target",
          r.text[:120])
    # invalid amounts

{"name": "bash", "output": "# Pocketful — stage 3

Statements and payment corrections on top of the stage-2 service.
Python 3 standard library only; no build steps, no runtime
dependencies, no outbound network access required.

This stage extends stage 1 and 2 (all of whose behaviour continues to
apply) with:

- per-payment revision histories and `POST /payments/{id}/corrections`
  (the eighth idempotent write path), `GET /payments/{id}/revisions`

- `GET /statement` — the caller's money movements in `[from, to)` with

{"name": "write", "args": {"content": "# Pocketful — stage 4

Refunds and batch corrections on top of the stage-3 service.
Python 3 standard library only; no build steps, no runtime
dependencies, no outbound network access required.

This stage extends stages 1–3 (all of whose behaviour continues to
apply) with ten idempotent write paths:

- `POST /payments/{id}/refunds` (9th) — the original receiver refunds a
  payment (direct, request, capture or settlement member; never a refund).
  The refund is a new reverse-direction payment linked by `refund_of`,
  paid from the receiver's available funds. Cumulative refunds cannot
  exceed the payment's current corrected amount.
- `POST /correction-batches` (10th) — settlement operators correct
  several payments in one request (1..32, distinct payment_ids),
  including every member of a settlement at one shared effective instant.
  All new revisions share one `recorded_at` and carry `correction_batch_id`.
- payments expose `refund_of` (null except refunds); revisions expose
  `correction_batch_id` (null except batch corrections)
- a correction cannot reduce a payment below its already-refunded amount
- captures and refunds are immutable to corrections (single or batch)
- the service accepts exports from stages 1–3, retaining settlement
  membership, corrections and snapshots

## Build (Docker)

```sh
docker build -t pocketful-stage4 .
```

## Run (Docker)

```sh
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 -e PORT=8080 pocketful-stage4
```

The container listens on `0.0.0.0:$PORT` (default 8080). State is
in-memory; a restart starts empty.

## Run (native)

```sh

```

## Verify

curl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health
# -> {"status": "ok"}

The UI is served at `http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/` for `Accept: text/html`
requests; the same paths return JSON to API clients.

Then, from the official package (with a fresh `--out` folder per run; the

env -u https_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY \

  --previous-base-url http://127.0.0.1:<stage3-port> \
  --stage 4 --out <fresh-out-folder>
```

1: # Pocketful — Stage 4: refunds and batch corrections
2: 
3: Recipients can refund payments. Settlement operators can correct several payments in
4: one request, including payments that belong to a settlement. Existing receipts and saved
5: statements must remain available in their original form.
6: 
7: All requirements from stages 1–3 continue to apply. There are ten idempotent write paths:
8: stage 1's five, authorizations and captures from stage 2, corrections from stage 3, and refunds and
9: correction batches in this stage.
10: 
11: ## Refunds and corrected history
12: 
13: `POST /payments/{payment_id}/refunds`, body `{"amount": 200}`, requires an idempotency key.
14: Only the original receiver may refund, else 403 `forbidden`; unknown payment is 404. The
15: target may be a direct payment, request payment or capture, but never a refund. Invalid amount
16: is 422 `validation_failed`. Refunds cumulatively may not exceed the payment's current corrected
17: amount: 422 `refund_exceeds_payment`. Refunds of refunds give 422 `invalid_refund_target`.
18: 
19: A refund is a new payment in the opposite direction, with `refund_of` naming the target,
20: `request_id: null`, `authorization_id: null`, and the original note/visibility. Return 201
21: with that payment; replay returns 200 with the original body. It moves existing money from
22: the receiver's **available** funds, or fails 409 `insufficient_funds`, atomically. Refunds
23: never reopen a request or authorization or restore a released hold. Other payments have
24: `refund_of: null`.
25: 
26: Stage-3 corrections remain available for ordinary direct/request payments. Captures and
27: refund payments cannot themselves be corrected: 422 `linked_payment_immutable`. A correction
28: cannot reduce a payment below its already-refunded amount: 422 `refund_exceeds_payment`.
29: Correction debits are checked against available funds.
30: 
31: ## Batch corrections
32: 
33: `POST /correction-batches` requires a settlement operator and an idempotency key, with the
34: same 401/403 rules as settlements. Body:
35: 
36: ```json
37: {"corrections": [{"payment_id": "p_a", "expected_revision": 1, "amount": 0,
38:                   "effective_at": "2026-09-20T12:00:00+00:00", "reason": "reversal"},
39:                  {"payment_id": "p_b", "expected_revision": 1, "amount": 0,
40:                   "effective_at": "2026-09-20T12:00:00+00:00", "reason": "reversal"}]}
41: ```
42: 
43: corrections contains 1..32 objects with distinct payment_ids, else 422 `validation_failed`.
44: Every item has the ordinary correction fields and validation. Unknown payment is 404;
45: a stale expected revision is 409 `stale_revision`. The operator may correct ordinary,
46: request and settlement payments, but captures and refunds remain immutable. Correcting any
47: settlement member requires including every member of that settlement, else 422
48: `incomplete_settlement`. Members of one settlement must have identical effective instants
49: (offset spellings may differ), else 422 `validation_failed`. Ordinary single-payment
50: corrections remain available for nonmembers. Unknown fields are ignored.
51: 
52: Error precedence is: item errors in input order, settlement completeness, resulting
53: current available funds, then historical total and available funds at every effective/event
54: boundary. The existing codes apply: `linked_payment_immutable`, `refund_exceeds_payment`,
55: `insufficient_funds`, `historical_overdraft`. Affordability is determined by the combined
56: effect of all proposed revisions. A rejected batch leaves history, balances and idempotency
57: records unchanged.
58: 
59: Return 201 with `correction_batch_id`, `recorded_at` and `revisions` in input order. All new
60: revisions share recorded_at, strictly later than the previous recorded_at of every member;
61: each revision also exposes correction_batch_id. Effective times cannot be later than now.
62: Original payments and receipts never change. Original payment and settlement retries return
63: their original bodies. New statements reflect the new revisions; earlier snapshot tokens
64: continue to page their frozen entries. Replays return the original batch response with 200.
65: This adds one idempotent write path.
66: 
67: A settlement payment may be refunded under the existing refund rules, but refunds never
68: change settlement membership. Concurrent corrections sharing any expected payment revision
69: cannot
70: both succeed. A stage-4 service must accept exports produced by the same team's stages 1–3,
71: retaining settlement membership, corrections and snapshots.

# Pocketful — stage 4

Refunds and batch corrections on top of the stage-3 service.
Python 3 standard library only; no build steps, no runtime
dependencies, no outbound network access required.

This stage extends stages 1–3 (all of whose behaviour continues to
apply) with ten idempotent write paths:

- `POST /payments/{id}/refunds` (9th) — the original receiver refunds a
  payment (direct, request, capture or settlement member; never a refund).
  The refund is a new reverse-direction payment linked by `refund_of`,
  paid from the receiver's available funds. Cumulative refunds cannot
  exceed the payment's current corrected amount.
- `POST /correction-batches` (10th) — settlement operators correct
  several payments in one request (1..32, distinct payment_ids),
  including every member of a settlement at one shared effective instant.
  All new revisions share one `recorded_at` and carry `correction_batch_id`.
- payments expose `refund_of` (null except refunds); revisions expose
  `correction_batch_id` (null except batch corrections)
- a correction cannot reduce a payment below its already-refunded amount
- captures and refunds are immutable to corrections (single or batch)
- the service accepts exports from stages 1–3, retaining settlement
  membership, corrections and snapshots

## Build (Docker)

```sh
docker build -t pocketful-stage4 .
```

## Run (Docker)

```sh
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 -e PORT=8080 pocketful-stage4
```

The container listens on `0.0.0.0:$PORT` (default 8080). State is
in-memory; a restart starts empty.

## Run (native)

```sh
PORT=18091 python3 app.py
```

## Verify

```sh
curl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health
# -> {"status": "ok"}
```

The UI is served at `http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/` for `Accept: text/html`
requests; the same paths return JSON to API clients.

Then, from the official package (with a fresh `--out` folder per run; the
stage-3 service must be running for the upgrade checks):

```sh
cd <official-package>
env -u https_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY \
  NO_PROXY="127.0.0.1,localhost" no_proxy="127.0.0.1,localhost" \
  python -m harness run --track pocketful --base-url http://127.0.0.1:$PORT \
  --previous-base-url http://127.0.0.1:<stage3-port> \
  --stage 4 --out <fresh-out-folder>
```
